Kestrel runs inside Android System WebView, and this phone doesn\'t have a working one. It may be turned off in your phone\'s app settings, or it may need an update from your app store.

Google's last security fixes for Android 9 came out in January 2022. Kestrel works here, but holes in Android found since then stay open on this phone, and a harmful app or website could use one to follow your location.

Android 9 also can't limit location to "only while using the app", so the permission covers all the time. Kestrel only reads your location while you're using it or sharing.

If you can, use a newer phone.
